name: Kazuya Shiranami
source:
Kazuya Shiranami was the first male member of the Rune Angel Troupe. He pilots the Brave Heart, which has the unique ability to combine with the NEUE Emblem Frames.

Kazuya is a dilligent and hardworking young man, but is rather docile and occasionally quite meek. He is also easily embarrassed, especially by members of the opposite sex. However, he is also courageous under pressure and cares deeply for his teammates.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Kazuya_Shiranami]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
